message.markdown:
Starting October 7th, we are migrating our status page to a new platform to give you better visibility into Supabase's service status.

What's changing:

The status page URL will stay the same: https://status.supabase.com

If you are subscribed via email, you will automatically be resubscribed, no action needed.

If you are subscribed via any other method (SMS, Slack, webhook, RSS, etc.), you will need to resubscribe on the new page, since these subscriptions will not carry over automatically. Note that our new platform only offers Email, RSS, and Slack notifications.

What's new:

The new status page lets you choose exactly what you want updates about. Instead of getting notified about all products, services and regions, email subscribers can now subscribe to only the specific products, services, and regions relevant to them. You will hear about the incidents that actually affect you.

Thanks, The Supabase Team
